skillDispatch.when: Changing backend libraries, framework APIs, persistence adapters, or runtime configuration.
Designing backend contract, integration, or failure-path tests.
Fixing backend defects, boundary failures, or data inconsistencies.

rules.guidance: Keep blocking, network, process, database, and daemon boundaries explicit about ownership, cancellation, timeouts, and error reporting. Test the lowest real boundary that proves the repository-authored contract; do not invent authentication, database, or transport policy.
